choices.hierarchy: Normal normal maximum marginal likelihood separately for logit b and natural log ell; fixed mean per UTC calendar date; common nonnegative between span sigma; within errors are standard deviations of 400 transformed parametric bootstrap estimates
choices.intervals: Profile likelihood 90 percent using chi square one degree threshold with zero included at boundary; 400 parametric hierarchy bootstrap intervals beside
choices.future_day_limit: A separate mean for a third UTC date is not identified by two fitted fixed day means. The primary hierarchy alone cannot issue an unrestricted third day forecast. Any additional forecast uses an explicitly separate conditional empirical day extension.
choices.leave_one_job_out: Predict using remaining same date class if present; otherwise original day specific mean unavailable and report pooled training class as separate conditional extension. Include heldout estimator uncertainty when comparing fitted point estimates.
